ActLink.description: One hop of the act chain: a principal and the action of theirs that led here.

action_id.description: Their action that caused this one.
action_id.title: Action Id

ActLink.title: ActLink

ActionClass.description: Action class, fixed before the action runs (RES-02). Unknown values are rejected by the schema.
ActionClass.title: ActionClass

Control.description: C4 Control: one containment operation, recorded in clear on its record.

alert_id.description: Alert that caused it, if any.
alert_id.title: Alert Id

auto.description: True if issued without a human click (hard alert). Revoke is never auto.
auto.title: Auto

epoch.description: New epoch for agent targets of suspend/revoke/release; ``None`` otherwise.
epoch.title: Epoch

issued_by.description:
``ks.monitor``/``ks.gateway`` if auto; ``ks.operator``/``ks.recovery`` if human-approved. Must equal the
signing envelope's ``agent_id`` (Record validator).
issued_by.title: Issued By

target.description: What it acts on: agent, connection, held action or outbox item (``ks.control.target``).
target.title: Target

Control.title: Control

EnvelopeHeader.description: The envelope with ``args`` replaced by ``args_hash``. This is what is signed and what records embed.

act_chain.description:
Full act chain, root first, immediate parent last; empty = self-initiated (``ks.act_chain``).
Agent-declared: used to deny revoked ancestors, NEVER for taint (taint uses recorded read sets).
act_chain.title: Act Chain

agent_id.description: Claimed signer (OTel ``gen_ai.agent.id``). Trusted only if the record's ``sig_ok`` is true.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

args_hash.description: ``args_hash(args)``; args themselves in the side store (OTel ``ks.tool.call.arguments_hash``).
args_hash.title: Args Hash

claimed_seq.description: Agent-claimed sequence, kept for evidence only; never becomes the record ``seq``.
claimed_seq.title: Claimed Seq

claimed_ts_us.description: Agent-claimed time, kept for evidence only; ordering uses gateway ``seq``/``ts_us``.
claimed_ts_us.title: Claimed Ts Us

epoch.description:
Agent's credential epoch (learned from ``TickFrame.epoch``); stale -> ``deny/stale_epoch``, checked inside
the write txn (``ks.agent.epoch``).
epoch.title: Epoch

expiry_tick.description:
Last tick at which the envelope is valid; later, or more than MAX_EXPIRY_TICKS ahead -> ``deny/expired``
(``ks.envelope.expiry_tick``).
expiry_tick.title: Expiry Tick

nonce.description: Anti-replay nonce, unique per agent_id (``ks.envelope.nonce``). Not used for dedupe.
nonce.title: Nonce

parent_action_id.description: Immediate parent action; equals ``act_chain[-1].action_id`` (OTel span link, ``ks.action.parent_id``).
parent_action_id.title: Parent Action Id

EnvelopeHeader.title: EnvelopeHeader

ReadEntry.description: One entry of a read set: what an adapter observed, captured by the gateway (OTel ``ks.read_set``).

hash.description: Value hash of the version read.
hash.title: Hash

ReadEntry.title: ReadEntry

VersionRef.description: A version plus the hash of its value (no raw value).

hash.description: ``value_hash(value)`` of that version; the value itself is in the side store.
hash.title: Hash

VersionRef.title: VersionRef

WriteEntry.description: One entry of a write set (OTel ``ks.write_set``).

after.description: Version created; ``after.hash == TOMBSTONE_HASH`` for a delete.

before.description: Version replaced; ``None`` = object did not exist (create).

WriteEntry.title: WriteEntry

description: C2 Record. Field docs give the OTel mapping (span name ``execute_tool {tool}``).

action_class.description: R | C | I1 | I2 | U, assigned before execution (``ks.action.class``).

control.description: The Control in clear, iff ``envelope.tool == "ks.control"`` and executed (``ks.control.*``).

envelope.description: Signed envelope header as received (claimed agent_id, act_chain, args_hash, sig). ``None`` iff unparseable.

envelope_hash.description: ``envelope.content_hash()``; for unparseable input, ``raw_hash(bytes)`` (raw in side store).
envelope_hash.title: Envelope Hash

gw_sig.description: Gateway Ed25519 over :meth:`signing_bytes` (``ks.record.gw_sig``). ``None`` only before signing.
gw_sig.title: Gw Sig

outbox_ids.description: Outbox items created, in creation order (``ks.outbox_ids``). Empty unless exec.
outbox_ids.title: Outbox Ids

policy_rule.description: Policy rule id that decided, if any (``ks.policy.rule``).
policy_rule.title: Policy Rule

prev_hash.description: ``hash`` of record seq-1; GENESIS_HASH for seq 1 (``ks.record.prev_hash``).
prev_hash.title: Prev Hash

read_set.description:
Versions the adapter read **plus every ``TickFrame.view`` entry delivered to the agent this tick** (I1),
sorted by obj (``ks.read_set``). Field objects per C3 X2. Empty on deny.
read_set.title: Read Set

reason.description: Why; ``ok`` for exec (``ks.policy.reason``; also ``error.type`` on deny).

reexec_of.description:
Seq of the ``hold`` record whose envelope this record re-executes after ``unhold action:<record_id>``
(M10); same ``envelope_hash``, nonce/expiry not re-checked. ``None`` for a normal admission.
reexec_of.title: Reexec Of

result_hash.description: Hash of the result returned to the agent (OTel ``gen_ai.tool.call.result``, hashed). Exec only.
result_hash.title: Result Hash

sig_ok.description: Gateway verified ``envelope.sig`` against the claimed principal's key (``ks.envelope.sig_ok``).
sig_ok.title: Sig Ok

ts_us.description: Gateway logical time from the tick, never wall clock (span start time).
ts_us.title: Ts Us

write_set.description: Versions written, before/after ver+hash, sorted by obj (``ks.write_set``). Empty unless exec.
write_set.title: Write Set

title: Record
